```abap
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
*      -->P_SUFFIX     Präfix (variablen Typs)                         *
*      <--P_CONT_NAME  Containername                                   *
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM R_CONCAT_CONT_NAME USING    VALUE(P_SUFFIX)
                        CHANGING P_CONT_NAME.
  STATICS: L_SUFFIX(3) TYPE C,
           L_I TYPE I.
  L_I      = P_SUFFIX.
  L_SUFFIX = L_I.
  CONCATENATE CONT_NAME_PRAEFIX L_SUFFIX INTO P_CONT_NAME.
ENDFORM.                               " R_CONCAT_CONT_NAME
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      Form  R_COMPLETE_CONTAINER_ATTR
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*       RPY_DYNPRO_READ:                                               *
*       Attribute des aktuellen Containers werden aus den Attributen
*       aller Felder im internen Format, die zu diesem Container
*       gehören, zusammengesetzt
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
*      -->P_FIELDLIST_INT_EXTEND  erweiterte Feldliste (intern)        *
*      -->P_DYNP_CONTAINERS       Container-Liste                      *
*      <->P_CONT_ATTR             Attribute des aktuellen Containers   *
*       ->P_DYNP_HEADER           Dynpro-Header (intern)               *
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM R_COMPLETE_CONTAINER_ATTR
        TABLES P_FIELDLIST_INT_EXTEND TYPE FIELDLIST_INT_EXTEND
               P_DYNP_CONTAINERS      type DYCATT_tab
               p_params_int           structure d023s
        USING  P_CONT_ATTR            TYPE RPYTY_DYNP_CONTAINER_ATTR
               r_property_bag    type ref to cl_dynpro_property_bag
               r_cntcmp          type ref to cl_dynpro_control_composite
               VALUE(P_DYNP_HEADER)   TYPE DYNPRO_HEADER.

  LOCAL: P_DYNP_CONTAINERS.
  STATICS: S_LENG TYPE I,
           S_VLENG TYPE I,
           S_LAST_COL TYPE I,
           S_LAST_COL_ACT TYPE I,
           S_LAST_LINE_ACT TYPE I,
           BEGIN OF S_CONT_LIST OCCURS 0,
             NAME LIKE P_CONT_ATTR-NAME,
             TYPE LIKE P_CONT_ATTR-TYPE,
           END OF S_CONT_LIST,
           s_params_x type d023s_x,
           s_params_xh type d023s_xh,
           S_CONT_A type RPY_DYCATT,
           s_field type rpy_dyfatc,
           f_res1 like d021s_res1.

```
